title: Analysis-Nvidia's CEO prepares investors for a renewed battle with Intel, AMD
title_zh: 分析——英伟达首席执行官让投资者为与英特尔、AMD 的新一轮战斗做好准备
summary: Nvidia may have made its immense fortune on the back of specialized graphics processing units (GPUs) used to power artificial intelligence servers, but CEO Jensen Huang is increasingly professing his love for the more generalist CPU.
summary_zh: 英伟达可能靠为人工智能服务器提供动力的专用图形处理单元 (GPU) 发了巨额财富，但首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 越来越多地表达了他对更通用的 CPU 的热爱。

title: OpenAI hires ex-Apple models head from Meta, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 从 Meta 聘请了前苹果模型主管
summary: OpenAI has hired Ruoming Pang, a high-profile AI ‌researcher at Meta, who had joined ‌the company from Apple about seven months ​ago, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing an OpenAI spokesperson.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 周三援引 OpenAI 发言人的话说，OpenAI 已聘请 Meta 的知名人工智能研究员庞若明（Ruoming Pang），他大约七个月前从苹果公司加入该公司。

title: Amazon's $50 billion OpenAI investment may depend on IPO or AGI, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，亚马逊 500 亿美元的 OpenAI 投资可能取决于 IPO 或 AGI
summary: Amazon's plan to invest up to $50 billion in OpenAI could depend on whether ‌the AI developer goes public or achieves an artificial ‌general intelligence (AGI) milestone, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar ​with the matter.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 周三援引知情人士的话报道，亚马逊向 OpenAI 投资高达 500 亿美元的计划可能取决于该人工智能开发商是否上市或实现通用人工智能 (AGI) 里程碑。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures wobble after Nvidia's big earnings, forecast beats
title_zh: 今日股市：英伟达公布巨额盈利、超出预期后，道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货波动
summary: With all eyes on AI darling Nvidia's earnings report, the company didn't disappoint, handily beating Wall Street expectations.
summary_zh: 在所有人的目光都集中在人工智能宠儿英伟达的盈利报告上，该公司并没有令人失望，轻松超出了华尔街的预期。

title: Wall Street extends tech-powered rally as AI; Nvidia reports
title_zh: 华尔街将科技驱动的涨势延伸至人工智能；英伟达报告

title: Nvidia earnings live: Nvidia stock pops as earnings beat, guidance stifles some AI concerns
title_zh: 英伟达财报直播：英伟达股价因盈利超出预期而上涨，指引抑制了一些人工智能担忧
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rally on tech jolt as Nvidia earnings loom
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数因科技股震荡而上涨，英伟达财报临近
summary: The major gauges gain ahead of a highly anticipated earnings report from Nvidia.
summary_zh: 在英伟达发布备受期待的收益报告之前，主要股指上涨。

title: Scaramucci warns Trump Slump is hurting markets
title_zh: 斯卡拉穆奇警告特朗普的暴跌正在损害市场
summary: Opening Bid Unfiltered is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts.
summary_zh: 未过滤的公开投标可在 Apple 播客、Spotify、YouTube 或任何您获取播客的地方使用。

title: Anthony Scaramucci on Trump Slump and crypto crash
title_zh: 安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇谈特朗普暴跌和加密货币崩盘
summary: Opening Bid Unfiltered is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts. Some on Wall Street are calling it the Trump Slump. The president’s signature tariffs were struck down by the Supreme Court, dealing a fresh blow to the White House.
summary_zh: 未过滤的公开投标可在 Apple 播客、Spotify、YouTube 或任何您获取播客的地方使用。华尔街的一些人称之为“特朗普暴跌”。总统签署的关税被最高法院否决，给白宫带来了新的打击。
